name: Salinas Beach Restaurant
description_short: Beachfront sushi and seafood with sweeping views over Wilderness lagoon and ocean.
description_long:
Perched right on Wilderness beach where the lagoon meets the sea, Salinas delivers fresh sushi, grilled seafood, and Japanese-inspired dishes with one of the Garden Route's most spectacular settings. The expansive deck puts you metres from the sand, with views stretching across the lagoon to the Outeniqua mountains.

The menu balances crowd-pleasing sushi platters and poke bowls with grilled linefish, calamari, and prawns. Families appreciate the relaxed vibe and kids' options, while the sunset cocktails draw a younger crowd. Service can be stretched during peak season, but the location more than compensates.

Accessible via Zundorf Lane off George Road, it's a prime stop after a beach walk or paddle on the lagoon. The outdoor seating fills quickly in summer, so book ahead for lunch or sundowners. Casual dress code, bare feet welcome.
